remarks: This 4-bedroom, 1-full-bath home offers a great opportunity for a buyer looking to add their own personal style and create a space that truly feels like home. The functional layout provides a solid foundation, while original details, including beautiful natural woodwork, add warmth, character, and timeless appeal. Enter through the covered front porch into the expansive living room, featuring a cozy fireplace that creates a warm and inviting atmosphere. Continue into the nicely sized dining room, which includes a versatile nook that could easily be used as a home office, reading area, or additional workspace. The dining room flows into the large kitchen, offering plenty of cabinetry and ample storage for everyday needs. Just off the kitchen is a convenient mudroom/laundry area, providing easy access to the attached 1 car garage. The original staircase, accented by beautiful natural woodwork, adds to the home's timeless character as it leads to the second-floor landing. A convenient linen closet is located just off the landing, providing additional storage for household essentials. The second floor offers four spacious bedrooms, each providing plenty of room for furnishings, personal touches, and everyday living. Whether used as bedrooms, guest accommodations, or flexible living space, the generous room sizes offer plenty of versatility. A full bathroom is conveniently located on the second floor and features direct access into one of the bedrooms, adding an extra level of privacy and convenience. Throughout this level, the original details and generous proportions help showcase the character and potential of this classic home. With some updating and personal touches, this property has plenty of potential to become a comfortable and inviting home while preserving the charm of its original features. Conveniently located near Griffis Sculpture Park, and just a short drive to Route 219, Village of Ellicottville, Holiday Valley Resort, and Allegany State Park. Enjoy easy access to shopping, dining, outdoor recreation, skiing, hiking, and all that the surrounding area has to offer, while still enjoying the comfort of a residential setting.
